card.name: Amount words ending in -ful before 'of'
card.fires_on: The end of a measure-of-quantity word such as glass-ful, spoon-ful or a dollop, just before 'of' and the substance. Also the 'g' in 'mcg'.

modes.label: Spoonful or glassful
modes.description: The 'ful' ending of a household measure before 'of' water or applesauce.
modes.example: diluted with a glass<<ful>> of water, taken four times a day

modes.label: Other quantity words
modes.description: Words like dollop, worth or layer that name an amount of a substance.
modes.example: Pour out a small dol<<lop>> of paint onto the paper plate.

modes.label: mcg unit
modes.example: contains no more than 25 mc<<g>>/L of aluminum
